works.body:
您好，チイツネchiitsune！
我是台灣Vtuber Kabung 很喜歡看你的插畫很可愛。
如果你不介意的話，你能畫我一下嗎？

我希望小太空人粉絲一同出現在畫面，就像和他們一起玩一樣。

OC簡介：我是太空站的船長，周邊有些許行星 

構圖:交給老師、姿勢交給老師

[使用] 我正在考慮將插圖用作社交媒體、縮圖、幻燈片等上的圖標！它還可以用於會員福利。

我想將其用作印製周邊，所以如果可能的話，您能否為我製作一個單獨圖層的 psd 檔案？ ( 如果您能提供 PSD 格式的角色和背景，將會很有幫
助。)
希望老師能夠答應

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZiPEJzkMQUTu3A_ywGbSexu7eI3VYfxZ?usp=sharing

Hello, sensei! Your art is so cute. Could you please draw my OCs?

- ネコ: She is 19 years old, black hair and fair skin. Her left eye is purple and right eye is blue. She is a kind, elegant and noble young lady. She is also an excellent magician.

- ナツ: He is 24 years old and has white hair, golden eyes and little tanned skin. As the commander of the Royal Knights, he is really mature, calm and intelligent.

Character Reference
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dtK4iitiqK6ubqyjehh5FJ0tEzqWWixh

Please feel free to draw

Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dtK4iitiqK6ubqyjehh5FJ0tEzqWWixh

Hello I love your cute chibi art!

If you are available, can I request 1 chibi of my Vtuber character Konoobi, without background in PNG format? I will put it on my weekly schedule that I post on twitter every week. 

She is a Fennec Fox girl. She is clumsy and energetic. She likes to dig in the sand with her shovel to find relics (little stones with drawings)
Reference Images: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZZHqtoaSpIe0S7KPfE97E-0XAlG5ZW6E?usp=sharing
Pose: She is jumping, and cheering happily. She has a shovel in one hand. She is lifting her other hand up to show a shiny relic that she found.

Thank you for the consideration! Thank you for your time!
Best regards,
Konoobi

Hello! My friend shared your latest art with the Pepes on the boyfriend and girlfriend's head and I'd like to buy her one as a gift. Could you draw my friend EvelynnDE in the same style with a Pepe on her head?

https://imgur.com/a/gtnh68d

I’m wanting to request 2 profile icons for me and my boyfriend. 

I’d also like for both to have a Pepe plush laying on top of their head. Here is an example: (https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/677647704930910228/1056045114130186240/1150058-2.png)

I’m wanting to turn the icons into GIFs, so I’d like if you can just draw each frame. I’d want each frame to be different mouth forms as if they’re talking, here is an example: (https://7tv.app/emotes/63504044eb772640dcb12380) You don’t have to draw many mouth shapes, about 5 mouth shapes is good.

A chest up or neck up illustration is good, I’d want the face to be the main focus.

Please provide a PSD with each mouth shape being in its own layer, this is important! Also separate the background. 

Here is my design: (https://imgur.com/a/FOrRcsF)

Here is my boyfriend’s design: (https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DGRuPU7UwAA96iX.jpg)

This will be used on various SNS and possibly animated

Your art is really cute! I'm making a request for my OC!

She has cat ears and tail like a Maine Coon. Her left eye color is red and her right eye color is blue. She likes cats and flowers. Please draw  her however you'd like!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iiJlI5pqHCJLr3I-97Pw7aJfkqt9aAc2?usp=sharing

Hi, I love your cute art style! Could you please draw these two VTubers?

Pose: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NfErRUrJYD4YSQ9OnXcusXj-6AhMnv1q/view?usp=sharing
You can leave the expressions as they are or change them to your liking!

Lower character (standing): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hEe-7bQ17ICgfn4Mf9e31JNAa6Vm9PXD/view?usp=sharing 
Her name is Ophelia Midnight. She is a yandere phantom. She has a strong maternal and chaotic personality.

Top character: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J3DGe16HYIC7PUWbVRfK7oDcVYLsG73z/view?usp=sharing 
Her name is Rana Ianna. She is a dragon raid boss. She is very difficult to get along with.

I would like to use her on YouTube/social media/merchandise. If possible, please separate the character and background as a .psd! Feel free to add poses and facial expressions if you like! Please do not cut off the head of the illustration. If possible, we would appreciate it if the dimensions of the illustration could be 16:9 (1920x1080 or larger).

Hello, your art is very cute so I would like to make a request! Can you draw my OC Selia (https://i.imgur.com/GT5qnjG.jpg), she's a bit tomboyish but very polite! She has a healthy appetite so can you draw her holding a basket of fruits and vegetables please?

Will you draw my character Unagi? He's a sweet boy who draws manga and is interested in fashion.
https://imgur.com/a/mNkSjOb

Hi!! I absolutely adore your art and would love to request an illustration of my character!

▼Character 
① MC (Ako)
Male, 175 cm 
He has light blue hair that tends to blend into the morning sky. His eyes are a gradient blue with white spiral pupils. He wears black glasses, piercings, and has a barcode tattoo around his neck. His expressions are gentle and melancholic. If he smiles, it’s small and subtle.

▼Request 
Please draw a chibi! Pose wise, you can draw freely. As for his clothes, please draw the outfit in his reference sheet.

▼Details
He is a pessimistic but selfless character who mostly smiles sadly. However, he is happier around small blue birds that like to rest on his finger.

Thank you for considering my request! <3
